subject: gov.legislate
name: Cybersecurity Law
milestone: Approved by Parliament, 26 January 2026
position_start: Did not exist; a cybercrime bill of August 2025 was the only instrument on record (2025-08)
position_end: In force, assigning policy to the communications ministry, technical oversight to the regulator and obligations to critical-infrastructure operators, and creating the incident response team (2026-01)
sources: 2026-01-29 Somali Parliament approves Cybersecurity Law amid rising threats
note: Somalia ranked in the ITU cybersecurity index's fifth tier at 37.39 of 100 in 2024 and is a Malabo Convention signatory.

subject: gov.protect
name: Data Protection Act (Law 005/2023)
milestone: In effect since 23 March 2023, with implementing regulations reviewed
position_start: In force, with lawful bases, data-subject rights and fines of 2-4% of worldwide turnover (2025-08)
position_end: In force and unamended; the Act does not define public data, which clouds the regulator's mandate (2026-08)
sources: 2024-06-11 Review of Somalia's Data Protection Act and implementing regulations

subject: gov.protect
name: Data Protection Authority
milestone: First nationwide enforcement step: mandatory registration under Article 32, June 2026
position_start: Inaugurated February 2024 and issuing guidelines, with no enforcement action on record (2025-08)
position_end: Requiring all controllers and processors to register and issuing compliance certificates; no penalty issued on record (2026-06)
sources: 2026-06-02-somalia-dpa-enforces-data-compliance-registration|2024-02-26 Somalia inaugurates its Data Protection Authority
note: Its independence is qualified by executive appointment and override powers.

subject: gov.protect

subject: gov.protect

milestone: Request made in a regulator statement of 6 July 2026 and restated by the minister on 22 July
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: Request outstanding with no platform response on record; Somalia is the second country after India to ask for a pause (2026-07)
note: The stated grounds are impersonation risk against the mobile-money system and loss of phone-number traceability in the campaign against al-Shabab.

subject: gov.regional
name: Accession to the African Continental Free Trade Area
milestone: Instrument of ratification to be deposited September 2026
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: Somalia is to become the 50th state party on depositing its instrument of ratification in September 2026, having agreed with the Secretariat at Mogadishu on 18 August 2026 a sequence running from ratification through domesticating the electronic tariff book and configuring preferential tariffs in the customs administration to completing outstanding East African Community tariff and services commitments and a first shipment, with the continental payment system and the AfCFTA Adjustment Fund named as the instruments available and the national chamber of commerce asking for access to services markets including telecommunications, logistics, finance and digital commerce
note: the Secretariat's own release; its standfirst dates the deposit to 2 September 2026 while its body says only September, and the wider month is what is carried here

subject: gov.regional
name: Connection to the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System
milestone: Stated by the Central Bank as a target for before the end of 2026

subject: finance.new

position_start: Approved 2023-05-18; implementation progress rated Unsatisfactory
position_end: US$162m IDA across the project after a US$10m partial cancellation in Somalia in April 2026; implementation progress raised to Moderately Unsatisfactory and overall risk from High to Substantial, with fiduciary and environmental-and-social risk both still High (2026-06-16)

position_end: Identity a pillar of the SPRING initiative of more than US$100m, with about US$125m more estimated to complete the rollout and no funding source named (2026-01)
sources: 2025-12-17 Somalia digital ID major pillar of World Bank-funded SPRING initiative|2026-01-12 Somalia estimates $125 million needed to complete national digital ID rollout

subject: infra.connect
name: Internet use and price
position_end: 10.7m internet users, more than half the population; median fixed download 18.76 Mbps, up 67% year on year; mobile data about US$0.50 per GB (2025-10)
note: Somalia ranks 191st on online government services in the same account.

subject: infra.connect
name: Starlink satellite service
milestone: Available nationwide from August 2025, four months after licensing
position_start: Licensed in April 2025 after about two and a half years of talks, not yet available nationwide (2025-08)
position_end: Available across the country at US$390 for hardware and US$70 a month, US$210 for the mini terminal, with a first local reseller from September 2025 (2025-09)
note: Licensed on a full foreign-ownership model without major public debate, which is the fastest such accommodation on the wiki's West and East African record.

subject: infra.connect
name: Submarine cable landings and their regulatory framework
milestone: First submarine cable landing technical working group opened with the IFC, June 2026
position_start: Landings at Mogadishu, Berbera and Bosaso with no submarine cable regulatory framework on record (2025-08)
position_end: Working group opened on outage management, competition and a regulatory framework; no framework published (2026-06)

subject: infra.store
name: National Data Centre, Mogadishu
milestone: Restated as planned by the state minister for communications, 2026-08-07
position_start: Under construction and described as nearing completion, not launched (2025-05)

note: the ministry's stated rationale - to end reliance on data storage outside the country - is also its statement that government data was held offshore when it spoke. A facility described as nearing completion in May 2025 is described as planned fifteen months later, and the record does not reconcile the two

position_start: No national coordination forum on record (2025-08)
position_end: First national DPI summit held in February 2026 with the Central Bank, the regulator, the identity authority and the data protection authority; no interoperability standard or role-clarity instrument published (2026-04)
sources: 2026-04-28-dpi-somalia-risks-repeating-old-mistakes|2026-01-29 Mogadishu to Host First National Digital Public Infrastructure Summit; Key Agencies to Map Out Digital Transformation Strategy

subject: dpi.exchange
name: Revenue and financial-management systems integrated with SFMIS
milestone: Auditor-General's 2025 annual audit
position_start: Not held
position_end: Seven government revenue and financial-management systems are not integrated with the state financial management information system, on the Auditor-General's 2025 annual audit; the same audit records 66 legal-compliance breaches across 22 audited bodies covering 60.1% of the national budget, including US$18.5m of contracts awarded without following committee procedures, and finds a port and airport revenue-share operator's reporting of US$38.08m of a combined US$42.24m could not be verified
note: the audit report itself is not held; the figures are as reported from it, and the seven systems are not named

subject: dpi.id
name: Compulsory use of the national identity credential
milestone: Enforced at Aden Adde airport for inter-state travel from March 2026
position_start: Required for bank accounts from 29 July 2025, with a passport requirement due from 1 September (2025-08)
position_end: Required for passports, bank accounts, driving licences, vehicle registration and domestic travel, and enforced for inter-state travel (2026-03)
note: A published legal analysis holds that the presidential proclamation of September 2025 exceeds Law 009/2023, which confers a right to an identity credential and imposes no duty to obtain one; the two accounts have not been reconciled.

subject: dpi.id
name: eAqoonsi mobile identity application
milestone: Public adoption call renewed; app past 50,000 downloads
position_start: Launched alongside the HUBIYE verification platform and the certificate delivery system, all built in-house (2025-05)
position_end: The identification and registration authority renewed its public call for citizens to adopt the digital identity application, restating that the app-held credential is legally equivalent to the physical national identity card; the app had passed 50,000 downloads by August 2026 against more than one million digital identities issued as of November 2025, a stated target of 15 million by 2029, and an estimated US$125m still needed to implement the donor-funded programme in full, with inclusion complaints over weak connectivity and low digital literacy reported in April 2026

subject: dpi.id
name: HUBIYE consent-based verification platform
milestone: Launched with the certificate delivery system and the mobile identity application
position_start: In service as the verification layer for the national identity credential (2025-08)
position_end: In service; no verification volume or integrated-institution count published (2026-08)

subject: dpi.id
name: Member state participation in the national identity system
status: Implemented, not adopted in two member states
milestone: Puntland operating its own identification authority
position_start: Puntland and Jubbaland declining to implement the federal credential (2025-08)
position_end: Position unchanged, with Puntland running a separate authority and citing data control, election influence and regional autonomy (2025-09)

subject: dpi.id
name: National passport
milestone: Cabinet approved a third-generation e-passport plan, 6 August 2026
position_start: 10m passports in circulation with no record of how many were lawfully issued (2025-09)
position_end: Cleared in February 2026 to adopt and print the East African Community e-passport, and a third-generation plan approved by Cabinet; no issuance date published (2026-08)

subject: dpi.id
name: Somali National Identity credential (SNID)
milestone: About 2m registered by April 2026
position_start: Issued since September 2023 from a near-zero base, with mass registration not yet launched (2025-08)
position_end: About 2m registered against a target of 15m by the end of 2029, with more than 24 services integrated (2026-04)
sources: 2026-04-24-somalia-eaqoonsi-app-dpi|2025-11-26-somalia-national-id-issuance-reaches-1m|2025-09-17 Somalia launches mass registration drive for its foundational digital ID
note: About 85% of an estimated 19.7m population held no legal identity, and fewer than 16% a government one, at the 2022 household survey.

subject: dpi.pay
name: EVC Plus mobile money
milestone: GSMA Mobile Money re-certified, August 2025
position_start: Operating as the dominant private rail, uncertified in the current cycle (2025-08)
position_end: Re-certified against about 300 criteria, one of about ten platforms worldwide to hold it, serving 4.5m daily users and used by more than 145 aid organisations (2025-08)
note: Nationally, mobile money runs about 155m transactions a month worth US$2.7bn on World Bank figures, against formal banking reaching about 15% of Somalis.

subject: dpi.pay
name: Somalia Instant Payment System (SIPS)
milestone: Central Bank set out the integration sequence, 26 July 2026
position_start: Live since January 2025 with seven institutions, operated on a commercial switching platform (2025-08)
position_end: Carrying person-to-person, merchant, government-to-person and person-to-government flows on ISO 20022, targeting 14 commercial banks and eight mobile money and e-wallet providers; mobile money integration has no published date (2026-07)
sources: 2026-07-26-sonna-central-bank-one-payments-network|2026-07-27-somalia-expand-instant-payment-system-hiiraan|2025-03-25 Somalia taps BPC to launch first nationwide instant payment system
note: Operated by the Somalia Payment Switch, a joint venture of the Central Bank and 13 commercial banks, which the Governor described as a deliberate choice over central-bank-run infrastructure.

sources: 2026-01-16 OpenCRVS Somalia Unified Digital Civil Registration System|2025-08-11 Somalia pilots 19-district digital civil registry|2025-01-14-somalia-civil-registration-overhaul
